body.p: REMARKS
I. Status and Disposition of the Claims

In this application, claims 1-6 are pending and stand rejected with claim 1 being independent claim. Further, by this response, Applicants have amended claim 1 to incorporate allowable subject matter of claim 5 in the independent claim 1. As a result, Applicants have cancelled dependent claim 5. Claim 4 has been amended for minor informalities. No new matter has been added. Thus, in this application, claims 1-4 and 6 are pending with claim 1 being independent claim. A listing of claims is solely provided for the Examiner's convenience. Favorable consideration and allowance of the subject application is respectfully requested in view of the following remarks.
In the Office Action1, the Office:
(i) rejected claims 1-4 and 6 under 35 U.S.C. § 103 as being unpatentable over
US Application No. US 20170173200 Al ("Wyman") in view of US Application No. US 20170246332 Al ("Marshalf') in further view of EP
Application No. EP 3061465 Al ("Mackin").
(ii) objected to claim 5, however, would be allowable if rewritten in independent
form including all the limitations of the respective base claim and any
intervening claims.

Applicants submit that the pending claims are patentably distinct and allowable over the references cited by the Examiner. Applicants cordially invite the Examiner to discuss the responses below with the undersigned at any time.
II. Allowable Subject Matter

1 The Office Action may contain characterizations of the claims and the related art, or the law, with which Applicants do not necessarily agree. Unless expressly noted otherwise, Applicants decline to automatically subscribe to any statement or characterization in the Office Action.
Applicants thank the Examiner for indicating that claim 5 would be allowable if rewritten in independent form including all the limitations of the respective base claim and any intervening claims.
Applicants have amended independent claim 1 to include the elements of now cancelled claim 5. Applicants thus respectfully request allowance of the amended claim
1 based on the allowable subject matter incorporated therein.
Ill. Rejections under 35 U.S.C. 103

Applicants have amended independent claim 1 to incorporate allowable subject matter of cancelled claim 5. Accordingly, withdrawal of the rejection under 35 U.S.C. @ 103 is respectfully requested. Dependent claims 2-4 and 6 are also allowable because of their dependency on allowable base claims and also because of the subject matter separately claimed.
CONCLUSION
In view of the foregoing remarks, Applicants respectfully request reconsideration of this application and the timely allowance of the pending claims.

It is not believed that extensions of time are required, beyond those that may otherwise be provided for in accompanying documents. If, however, additional extensions of time are necessary to prevent abandonment of this application, then such extensions of time are hereby petitioned under 37 C.F.R. @ 1.136(a).
